name: Sign in, create a strong candidate, and reject a duplicate
description: Verifies the private ledger creates a scored opportunity, retains it in the dashboard, and prevents a duplicate record.
steps: Sign in to Job Fisher
Add candidate company "Northstar Health" and role "Member Advocate", then raise the projected fit score to at least 85
Submit the candidate and confirm it appears in the ledger
Try to add Northstar Health — Member Advocate a second time
expected: The first candidate remains visible with its fit score and a visible duplicate error prevents a second row.

name: Analyze a URL and show a persistent scan event
description: Verifies a readable URL can be analyzed, scored, saved to the ledger, and represented in scan analytics.
steps: Sign in and choose Analyze URL
Enter https://example.com and analyze it
Confirm a candidate sourced from example.com appears in the ledger
Open Scan analytics
expected: The imported opportunity is visible and Scan analytics shows a recent URL-analysis event.

name: Generate and retain an ATS application package
setup: Sign in and create company "Granite Care" with role "Patient Support Specialist"
description: Verifies Job Fisher generates a cautious job-specific resume and cover-letter package without inventing credentials.
steps: Open Granite Care — Patient Support Specialist
Choose Generate package
Wait for the package preview to appear
Close and reopen the candidate
expected: A persistent tailored application package is visible with ATS/resume, cover-letter, screening-guidance, and do-not-claim content.

name: Parse a recruiter message and dismiss it
description: Verifies a pasted hiring message becomes a structured inbox card with an action and suggested reply, then can be dismissed.
steps: Sign in and open Recruiter inbox

Paste: Hello Alexander, I reviewed your resume for the Veteran Care Specialist role at True Vet Solutions and would like to schedule a phone call. Please send a couple of times that work for you. — Jimmy
Choose Analyze & save and confirm a recruiter card with a suggested reply appears
Dismiss the recruiter card
expected: The structured hiring card appears with a next action and suggested reply, then disappears after dismissal.

name: Enforce queue guardrails, update status, and delete
setup: Sign in and create company "Harbor Labs" with role "AI Health Evaluator", score at least 85, and check Background-check authorization
Create company "Pine State Health" with role "Care Navigator" and score at least 85 with no mandatory stops
description: Verifies blocked jobs stay out of autonomous submission while clear high-fit jobs can advance and lifecycle changes persist.
steps: Open Application queue and confirm Harbor Labs shows a HOLD with Background-check authorization
Mark Pine State Health submitted
Open Pine State Health and confirm Submitted is visible
Delete Pine State Health and confirm deletion
expected: Harbor Labs remains blocked, Pine State Health advances to Submitted, and the deleted candidate no longer appears.
